description: Evaluate requester-supplied source code for a bounded time.

language.description: Lowercase identifier of the programming language to execute.

languageVersion.description: Exact advertised version of the selected programming language.

source.description: UTF-8 source code evaluated by the selected runtime.

maxExecutionMilliseconds.description: Requester-selected maximum execution time in whole milliseconds.

outcome.description: Completion outcome: result, timeLimitReached, or executionError.

billedMilliseconds.description: Whole execution milliseconds used to calculate the final price.

price.description: Final credits charged for this completed computation.

result.description: Runtime-defined UTF-8 result text; present only when outcome is result.

diagnostic.description: Unstandardized runtime diagnostic; permitted only when outcome is executionError.

check.description: Independently execute the original source with the same runtime pair and time limit, then compare result text when both executions return a result.

languageVersion.description: Exact language version from the checked invocation.

maxExecutionMilliseconds.description: Maximum execution time from the checked invocation.

originalOutcome.description: Outcome in the original completion record.

originalResult.description: Original result text; present only when originalOutcome is result.

outcome.description: Verification outcome: pass, fail, or inconclusive.

checkedOutcome.description: Completion outcome produced by the independent execution.

checkedResult.description: Result text produced by the independent execution, when it produced one.
